why: halesbarmarina.com/rv-park (read 2026-11-25): RV nightly rates $80 waterfront, $70 non-waterfront (middle and back rows), no lower season or weekday rate posted; over the US$50 gate, gateways.py finds no gateway within 40 km (nearest Nashville 168 km), and it is not in the Good Sam directory (trip_data/goodsam_parks.json), so no GS Park discount.
name: Hales Bar Marina & Resort

fees.note: $70 a night for a non-waterfront site and $80 for a waterfront site, electricity included; weekly $350/$400, monthly $825/$900 plus metered electric. Holiday weekends may cost more.

fees_source: https://halesbarmarina.com/rv-park, read 2026-11-25: 'Waterfront Sites ... Nightly Rate 80 Includes Electricity Weekly Rate 400 ... Monthly Rate 900'; 'Non-Waterfront Sites (Middle Row) ... Nightly Rate 70'; 'Non-Waterfront Sites (Back Row) ... Nightly Rate 70'; 'PRICES SUBJECT TO CHANGE FOR HOLIDAY WEEKENDS'. Wayback 2025-10-08 showed $75/$65/$60 and 2024-04-15 $80/$70/$60, all over $50.
flags: The lead said 'no rate posted'; the operator's RV Park page does post nightly rates, so this is a plain price-gate skip.
Booking is by phone only (423-942-9000); the page's 'Book Now' has no engine behind it. 53 paved full-hookup sites (50/30/20 A) in three rows (waterfront, middle, back), per the home page.
Google 4.0/1,144 (from the lead, not re-read) is shared with the marina, floating cabins and attractions, so it is not the RV park's alone.
No waterfront audit was run, since the entry is skipped on price.
